links.outcome: GPT-4V diagnostic accuracy on real-world retina clinic images, open-ended vs multiple-choice
links.effect: 13.7% accuracy for open-ended questions and 31.3% for multiple-choice questions; ICD-10 code accuracy 5.5% and 31.3%.
links.quote: In 256 eyes from 143 patients, Generative Pre-trained Transformer 4-V demonstrated a 13.7% accuracy for open-ended questions and 31.3% for multiple-choice questions, with International Classification of Diseases 10th revision code accuracies at 5.5% and 31.3%, respectively.

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of GPT-4V performance on diagnostic retinal image analysis and ICD-10 coding comparing open-ended and multiple-choice formats without testing a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
